workload: 50000 accounts with one stale repository each (scheduled audit admission), then 5000 queued jobs for each of 7 more kinds (source, monitor, dependency, graph, notification, repair, intelligence), about 85000 queued in total; 60 rounds of one claim per kind, all running jobs finished between rounds. The kind check is widened to migration 077's list; other 070 to 083 tables are not loaded.
finding: claim_execution_job ordered queued rows by run_after without kind, so a claim for a kind late in that order scanned the other kinds' queued rows: p95 413 ms, max 612 ms. Migration 089 adds a kind-first partial index: p95 0.37 ms, max 1.13 ms, same claims and fairness.
limitsObserved: Global running <= 8, per tenant <= 1 held in every round. Per kind reached 1 in the mixed phase (one claim per kind per round); the per-kind limit of 2 is exercised by the audit-only phase (thirdAuditClaimBlockedByKindLimit).
capsNotMeasuredHere: The per-account click caps (082, 083) are enforced and tested in scripts/test-foundation-sql.mjs; they are not load-tested here.
